content: Incorporating a systematic approach to assess, adopt, and integrate technology into Diabetes Self-Management Education and Support (DSMES) can enhance accessibility and promote equitable health outcomes. Technology-enabled solutions, such as virtual health platforms, digital coaching, and continuous glucose monitoring (CGM), are increasingly utilized to support diabetes self-management. These tools provide patients with the ability to monitor their condition in real time and receive immediate feedback. This structured approach ensures that technology is accessible and consistently applied across all patient groups. This is particularly advantageous for diverse populations with varying levels of health literacy, as it helps bridge gaps in understanding and access to care.
